Never import `react-select`, `date-fns`, or `axios` directly in a feature. Wrap once in `src/components/ui/` or `src/lib/`. When the library needs replacing, on
> **[Must-fix]** `src/features/posts/PostCard.tsx:12`: `fetch('/api/author/' + authorId)` inside a leaf component. Creates N+1 waterfall and un-cached requests.
